volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

waveform.tooltip: PolyBLEP waves. Pulse / Center Pulse / Trisaw use 50% width. All voices start in phase.

morph.tooltip: Width. 0.5 is the centered shape. Trisaw, Pulse, Center Pulse, and Square follow it. Saw and Ramp stay fixed.

stereoMode.tooltip: Dual Channel: the detuned bank is copied to Left and Right (same map, same start phase; 1 = one per channel at unison). Alternating: one bank, pans L R L R… across the detune stack (not low-half Left / high-half Right).

frequency.tooltip: Center pitch. Wired ƒ cancels Frequency. Detune is frequency-domain (each voice runs at a different Hz).

detuneAlgorithm.tooltip: Linear/Chordal/Classic/Exponential = RatioGenerator layouts mapped into ±Detune/2. Emotional & Realistic = same, then median cluster → unison and extremes re-stretched to ±Detune/2. Uniform = even spacing in cents.

detuneHz.tooltip: Total Hz spread across the voice stack (± half of this), added to ƒ. Walk rate does not scale with pitch. Face is phase vs the first oscillator.

voices.tooltip: Voice count (UI max 32, hard-cap 128). Dual Channel: N per Left and N per Right (same detune map). Alternating: N voices panned L R L R…. Decimal like Hypersaw (7.5 → last half amp).

phaseAlgorithm.tooltip: Circular phase layout in [0, 1). Linear = i/N (10 voices: 0, 0.1, … 0.9 — never 1, which is 0). Exponential bunches toward 0. Random draws per voice and re-rolls on Reset.

phaseMultiply.tooltip: Scales the phase layout. 0 = all voices aligned. 1 = algorithm as written. 2 = twice the offsets, wrapped. Envelope this to open dispersion after attack.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. Bypass = dry. LP / HP use LPF / HPF. BP is HP→LP in series (no cutoff swap — HPF above LPF collapses the band).

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). In BP, raising this past LPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). In BP, lowering this past HPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the HPF/LPF interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.

amplitude.tooltip: Output scale. Raise domain for large CV into ƒ (e.g. filter → frequency).

shape.tooltip: Analog = one-pole (infinite tail). Linear / Smoothstep / Log = finite 0…1 stretch. Log = analog-like fast-then-ease on attack and fall, no exponential tail.

attack.tooltip: Attack time. Modulatable. Gate↑ attacks from current level (no hard restart).

decay.tooltip: Decay time to Sustain × velocity. Modulatable.

sustain.tooltip: Sustain level (0…1), scaled by Gate velocity. Modulatable.

release.tooltip: Release time after Gate falls. Modulatable.

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet balance on the Mix outputs (not a wet-only path).

recycle.tooltip: Feedback amount for the reverb tail.

seed.tooltip: Randomizes the delay line pattern. Same seed always reproduces the same reverb character.

layout.text: The sound phenomenon when you 👋💥 a long metal object and hear a sharp, rapidly descending pitch is known as acoustic dispersion. Hyperpluck uses phase-distrubted sawtooths.
